title: kb-sprint and backlog.md say land moves intake drafts aside from a worktree made outside .claude/worktrees/, which land refuses to release
goal: kb/_self/backlog.md (Running a sprint, headless delegation) and .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md (run step 3) no longer say land moves intake drafts aside from a worktree made outside .claude/worktrees/: release_worker_worktree (_tools/bl_land.py, the worker_dirs check) refuses such a worktree, so land's draft handling covers only worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ (sessions started before ST-ocfkanth, older clones); the docs say what happens to drafts in a worktree made elsewhere. Found by the SP-gkbtjjce review.

run: import pathlib,sys;t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/backlog.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');bad='a worktree made elsewhere still gets them, and `land` moves them aside itself' in t;print('backlog.md claims land moves drafts from a worktree made elsewhere:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

repro_reason: The defect is the docs' wording: release_worker_worktree correctly refuses a worktree not under .claude/worktrees/, so no tool run shows the false sentence; the repro reads the sentence.
notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 5 of 13, "Headless sprint loop 2: intake drafts, land windows and worker cost"); it blocks no fitness test and no real user reported it, so it sits in a late sprint of the sequence.
